messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I knew we were almost there when my midwife's voice got more excited and Joey leaned in real close and said into my ear, `` Don't stop pushing! ''

output.original_text: I knew we were almost there when my midwife's voice got more excited and Joey leaned in real close and said into my ear, `` Don't stop pushing! ''
output.joy: I knew we were almost there when my midwife's voice filled with excitement and Joey leaned in closely, whispering into my ear, `` Don't stop pushing! ''
output.sadness: I knew we were almost there when my midwife's voice grew more excited, yet Joey leaned in too close and said softly into my ear, `` Don't stop pushing. ''
output.fear: I knew we were almost there when my midwife's voice became more excited and Joey leaned in, urgently whispering into my ear, `` Don't stop pushing! ''
output.anger: I knew we were almost there when my midwife's voice got annoyingly excited and Joey leaned in way too close, practically shouting into my ear, `` Don't stop pushing! ''
output.surprise: I knew we were almost there when my midwife's voice suddenly got more excited, and Joey leaned in so close, catching me off guard as he said into my ear, `` Don't stop pushing! ''
output.disgust: I knew we were almost there when my midwife's voice became overly excited, and Joey leaned in too closely, saying into my ear in a way that made me cringe, `` Don't stop pushing! ''
